artists.source_line: Dance to the rhythms of salsa, bachata, and kizomba with your captain, Steve Bakoula! 🎵💃🕺
Payment must be made by check payable to Martini Voyages: in 1, 2, or 3 installments maximum, cashed 1 month apart if you wish. Holiday vouchers are also accepted 💡

features.rationale: The event takes place on a cruise ship, named as the Costa Deliziosa.
Themed evenings are part of the cruise program.

features.quote: Daily dance lessons (2 hours of lessons per day onboard)
features.rationale: Daily dance lessons are included as part of the event.
The price includes the onboard accommodation package.
Full board is included in the price.
A round-trip bus transfer is included in the price.
